title: Preparation, identification, and anti-photoaging effect of royal jelly protein peptides on UVB-irradiated HaCaT cells.
authors: Li, Zhiwen; Liang, Jiayi; Feng, Jie; Xing, Hongyang; Wang, Ruiming; Li, Piwu; Su, Jing; Yang, Xiaohui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蜂王浆蛋白肽的抗光老化作用，涉及抗氧化和信号通路抑制，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to prepare and identify anti-photoaging peptides from royal jelly proteins (RJP), and to investigate their protective effects and molecular mechanisms against ultraviolet B (UVB)-induced photoaging in human keratinocytes. A low-molecular-weight peptide fraction (<3 kDa, P-RJP1) exhibiting high antioxidant activity was obtained through pepsin hydrolysis of RJP followed by ultrafiltration fractionation. It was found that P-RJP1 effectively restored the viability of UVB-irradiated human keratinocytes, and alleviated oxidative stress by enhancing the activity of antioxidant enzymes and reducing intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels. Furthermore, P-RJP1 attenuated UVB-induced cell damage and inflammatory responses by inhibiting the mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK)/nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) signaling pathway. Further purification of P-RJP1 by gel filtration chromatography yielded two major peptide fractions (F1 and F2). The F2 fraction, which exhibited superior antioxidant activity, was subjected to liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) for peptide sequence identification. Molecular docking revealed that the peptides FDYDFG, FDYDPKF, and FDL could establish stable hydrogen bonds with matrix metalloproteinase-1 (MMP-1) to inhibit its activity. These results indicated that P-RJP1 could effectively alleviate UVB-induced photoaging through multi-target effects.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在从蜂王浆蛋白（royal jelly proteins, RJP）中制备并鉴定抗光老化肽，并探讨其对人类角质形成细胞中紫外线B（UVB）诱导光老化的保护作用及分子机制。通过胃蛋白酶水解RJP及超滤分级，获得了一种具有高抗氧化活性的低分子量肽组分（<3 kDa，P-RJP1）。研究发现，P-RJP1能有效恢复UVB照射的人类角质形成细胞的活力，并通过增强抗氧化酶活性和降低细胞内活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）水平来缓解氧化应激。此外，P-RJP1通过抑制丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（mitogen-activated protein kinase, MAPK）/核因子κB（nuclear factor kappa B, NF-kappaB）信号通路，减轻了UVB诱导的细胞损伤和炎症反应。通过凝胶过滤色谱进一步纯化P-RJP1，获得两个主要肽组分（F1和F2）。其中，具有优异抗氧化活性的F2组分经液相色谱-串联质谱（LC-MS/MS）进行肽序列鉴定。分子对接结果显示，肽FDYDFG、FDYDPKF和FDL能与基质金属蛋白酶-1（matrix metalloproteinase-1, MMP-1）建立稳定的氢键以抑制其活性。这些结果表明，P-RJP1可通过多靶点效应有效缓解UVB诱导的光老化。
